sentences.text: Paracoccus yeei has been described as the first species in the genus to be implicated in opportunistic infections in humans.
A comparative physiological and genomic analysis presented P. yeei strains as a model for how bacteria shift from a saprophytic to a pathogenic lifestyle.
Paracoccus sanguinis is a Gram-negative bacterium isolated from human blood, and some of its metabolites suppressed reactive oxygen species and MMP-1 secretion in human dermal fibroblasts.
